text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo ends up learning how to run 
from Daitaku Helios. As a result, a whole 
new "rhythm" is added to her running 
style.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though a sprint route is considered, her 
greatest strength isn't raw speed, but her 
"decisiveness." She sets her sights on 
middle distance and beyond.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio also scores a win in her debut 
race. Twin Turbo gets even more fired up.
